interpretation: This compares the same A* terrain grid with vision cost disabled and enabled. It tests integration and path sensitivity only. Labels are weak DTM proxies; route change does not prove improved hazard avoidance.

runs.planner: A* over a local CTX stereo DTM

vision_model.test_metric_basis: weak DTM-derived labels; not independent visual ground truth
vision_model.model: dual-stream gated-fusion U-Net: CTX image plus TTA terrain geometry
vision_model.warning: Experimental model trained on weak DTM-derived labels; no human-reviewed visual hazard labels are available and scores are not calibrated safety probabilities.

terrain_assessment.method: 3×3 least-squares DEM plane slope, relief, plane-residual roughness, direction-aware downslope-aspect cross-slope edge penalty, plus optional image risk

class_thresholds.impassable: mapped dune, crater footprint/near-edge zone (≤0.5 km), or slope above 20.0°

semantic_factors_used: approximate crater footprint and edge avoidance
semantic_factors_not_scored: geology, wheel slip, travel time, energy, and safety probability are not modeled
the result is a terrain-cost route, not a rover-certified safety prediction
